label: Bible Study
prompt: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never _____. Believest thou this?
verse: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?
note: Jesus to Martha, four days after Lazarus died — and she answered with a full confession of faith.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive as the corn, and grow as the _____: the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon.
verse: They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive as the corn, and grow as the vine: the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon.
note: Hosea's finale: those who return under God's shadow revive like the corn and grow like the vine.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then the king commanded, and they brought Daniel, and cast him into the _____ of lions. Now the king spake and said unto Daniel, Thy God whom thou servest continually, he will deliver thee.
verse: Then the king commanded, and they brought Daniel, and cast him into the den of lions. Now the king spake and said unto Daniel, Thy God whom thou servest continually, he will deliver thee.
note: King Darius threw Daniel to the lions against his own wishes — and still told him his God would deliver him.

label: Deep Water
prompt: The LORD thy God will raise up unto thee a _____ from the midst of thee, of thy brethren, like unto me; unto him ye shall hearken;
verse: The LORD thy God will raise up unto thee a Prophet from the midst of thee, of thy brethren, like unto me; unto him ye shall hearken;
note: Moses promised a prophet like himself; Peter applies it to Jesus in Acts 3:22.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And whosoever shall _____ thee to go a mile, go with him twain.
verse: And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile, go with him twain.
note: Going the second mile starts here: compelled to go one mile? Go with him 'twain' — that's two.
